overview: The Public Health and Community Safety Committee met to review proposed ordinance protections for reproductive health and gender-affirming care, and to consider plans for installing public sanitary facilities in municipal parks.

items.title: Gender-Affirming Care and Reproductive Health Ordinances
items.summary: The committee reviewed draft language restricting city cooperation with out-of-state enforcement against healthcare services, requesting councilor feedback and approving a motion to draft additional language regarding pharmacy compliance for emergency contraception.

items.title: Public Sanitary Facilities in City Parks
items.summary: The committee discussed community needs and financial considerations regarding public restrooms in city parks, voting to solicit feedback from city department heads.
